subject: Taproot acceptance & smoke orchestration plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Donna Smith <donna.smith@acme-health.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Taproot acceptance & smoke orchestration plan

Hi Donna / Acme team,

We kicked off the private deployment handover this morning and I wanted to consolidate the acceptance + smoke orchestration plan for the Taproot private deployment (VPC + on-prem connector). Key goals for the window we discussed: validate ingress/egress routes, KV cache priming, prefix-cache performance, access logging, and the rollback trigger thresholds.

Proposed go-live window (please confirm):
- Dec 1 23:00 - Dec 2 01:00 UTC (we'll publish a 30m quiet period before traffic shift)

High-level run:
1) Preflight (2h before window): network ACL sanity, IGW/NAT route validation, certificate push verification, KMS connectivity (customer HSM validated).
2) Activation (window start): enable ingress, staged traffic ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m), KV cache priming script run across edge nodes.
3) Smoke (first 20m after 50%): run sample prompts, embd bench, and latency SLO checks.
4) Rollback criteria: token error rate > 1.5% over 5m OR median P95 latency regression > 300ms over baseline OR organic request failures to auth path.

Owners (first-responder):
- Network lead: Laura Bennett (routing / transit verification)
- Platform ops: Monica Patel (runbook execution, KV priming, metrics gating)
- Reliability: Vivek Kulkarni (SLO/trace checks, decisioning)
- Customer liaison: Donna Smith (KMS/HSM access & firewall egress confirmation)

Attachments: Taproot_Smoke_Runbook_v1.pdf (detailed steps), taproot-network-acceptance-checklist.csv (preflight matrix), taproot-rollback-snippets.txt (rollback command snippets).

Please confirm the window and call out any blocked items — I want to lock the bridge and Ops runbook by EOD PST.

Thanks,
Karthik
Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Donna Smith <donna.smith@acme-health.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Taproot acceptance & smoke orchestration plan

Thanks Karthik — high level looks good. A couple clarifications from Acme before we lock: 

1) KMS/HSM: we need confirmation that Redwood's control plane will not cache any unencrypted keys; our security team requires an HSM handshake over the new transit path during preflight. Can Monica confirm handshake verification steps?
2) Egress rules: our infra team will only allow specific destination IPs for outbound connections during activation. Can you provide the outbound IP list (or FQDNs) that the Taproot nodes will reach during KV priming and model downloads?
3) Bridge timing: the proposed window crosses our midnight maintenance window. Can we shift 1 hour earlier (22:00 - 00:00 UTC) to avoid a collision with nightly backups?

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:30:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Taproot acceptance & smoke orchestration plan — runbook excerpts and egress list

Donna — good questions. Quick answers and artifacts attached:

1) KMS handshake
- We will perform an HSM challenge/response during preflight using the key-wrapping handshake documented in Taproot_Smoke_Runbook_v1.pdf (section 3.2). The runbook includes the exact curl checks and expected response payloads.

2) Outbound IPs/FQDNs
- Primary egress (model pulls & KV priming): 
  - models.redwood-cdn.com (FQDN) -> resolves to dynamic CDN edges (we will provide an ASN/IP-range file for firewall allowlisting by EOD).
  - metrics.redwood-internal.com (FQDN) -> 3 static egress IPs: 54.183.12.45, 34.201.98.77, 18.207.43.153
  - auth.redwood-internal.com (FQDN) -> 52.14.77.9
- I'll attach a provisional IP allowlist: taproot-network-acceptance-checklist.csv (column A).

3) Window shift
- OK to shift earlier to 22:00 - 00:00 UTC on Dec 1 (we'll still call it the Dec 1 activation slot). That gives us a 30m quiet buffer. Confirmed in the runbook where timing is parameterized.

Runbook ownership & staging notes:
- Preflight checklist (Monica): verify certs, HSM challenge, static egress reachability, mech of route tables.
- KV priming (Aditya): run the priming job in batches of 500 prompts per node; results posted to the shared Drive folder.
- Observability checks (Vivek): ensure trace sampling at 100% for first 10m then revert. Preflight dashboard link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TaprootSmokePlan

I'll be in the bridge for preflight and activation. Attaching the runbook, checklist, and a short rollback snippets file.

—Monica
Sr. Platform Ops Engineer

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 01:45:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Taproot acceptance & smoke orchestration plan — preflight status and gating

Quick preflight readout from our checks (running now):
- Cert push: OK (all nodes report new certs, thumbprint match).
- HSM handshake: OK (validated with Acme HSM test endpoint; Monica's curl checks returned expected wrap token).
- Egress: 2/3 static IPs reachable from on-prem relay; one path fails for 34.201.98.77 — Laura is debugging (likely BGP広告 on the transit).
- KV priming dry run: Aditya ran batch 0 (no errors, 3% warm hit on next-run simulation).
- Tracing: sampling set to 100% for smoke window; dashboard reporting latency baseline.

Gating note: the one egress path failing must be remediated OR we must update the priming job to avoid the node behind that path. If we proceed without remediation, we should pin the routing for priming to confirmed edges only.

Rollback snippet reminder (from runbook):
- Command: sudo /opt/redwood/bin/taproot-rollback --stage ingress --reason "egress-failure" --force
- Post-rollback check: validate auth path and revert to previous route table.

I'll remain on the bridge for decisioning at T+10m. If the failing egress is not resolved by T-15m, recommend abort.

Vivek
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference
